correctness.rationale: For independent voters q_i=s a_i, the exact majority multilinear polynomial G5=1/2+3e1/8-e3/2+6e5 implies minimizing Q=A-12s² B. G3 depends only on e1 and e3, proving scale independence for committees of size 3 (and 1). General lower-envelope optimality inequalities force B nondecreasing with scale. Independently enumerated 126 unordered partitions of the ten abilities (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,11,15); verified A,B=(3346,6360) and (3352,7710) and margins 36,112/3,52 over the remaining 124 at u=0,1/2700,1/900, proving across the full continuum the unique critical s=1/(30 sqrt(3)), both candidates tie only at that scale. Proof affine interpolation handles all intermediate s; no sampled-only inference.
